search.title: Renaldo Major
search.snippet: Renaldo Major (born May 7, 1982) is an American professional basketball coach and former player. He was previously the head coach for the Fresno Fire

search.title: Renaldo Balkman
search.snippet: Renaldo Miguel Balkman (born July 14, 1984) is a Puerto Rican professional basketball player for Vaqueros de Bayamón of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional
